_about: The canvas change for #1544: a click sold buyer offered on a known Tripoint no in the Engine Bidding Workflow (da82a183-1a4a-417e-b0b8-5f3fe5e14840). Applied to the live definition by removing remove_edges and adding add_nodes and add_edges. Live node and edge ids were read from the bidspoke-workflows mirror on 2026-09-24 (version 100); the ids of the four new nodes are stand ins, because the canvas mints its own when the nodes are added. The drift check and the scripts find nodes by namespace, never by id. The guide is liberty1-wiring.md beside this file.
